options.name: Allied Spellcaster

options.benefit: Improve AC against flanking attacks while adjacent to an ally.

options.benefit: Act in surprise rounds alongside an adjacent ally.

options.name: Outflank
options.benefit: Gain stronger flanking bonuses and trigger allied attacks on critical hits.

options.benefit: Improve and share adjacent attacks of opportunity.

options.benefit: Combine shields with an adjacent ally for better AC.
